title: Integer lattice approximation with bounded boundary masses in every dimension
statement: Assume DeformationTheorem (Simon 5.3, frozen statement). Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let X ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity with M(X) < ∞ and M(∂X) < ∞. Then there are ρ_k > 0, β_k : LatticeFaceIndex (m+1) P → ℤ and P_k ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with IsLatticeChain ρ_k β_k P_k for all k, P_k ⇀ X weakly, and sup_k M(∂P_k) < ∞.
lean_statement: DeformationTheorem → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.mass < ∞ → X.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∃ (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (β : ℕ → LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) P → ℤ) (Pk : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), (∀ k, 0 < ρ k) ∧ (∀ k, IsLatticeChain (ρ k) (fun F => (β k F : ℝ)) (Pk k)) ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn Pk X ∧ (⨆ k, (Pk k).boundary.mass) < ∞
